clue.text: Undeveloped island Antarctic hero almost identified

parts.note: inch is a Scottish word for a small island

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of the name is dropped, leaving it just short

parts.note: Captain Lawrence Oates, who walked out into the blizzard on Scott's Antarctic expedition

explanation.surface: An undeveloped island where a polar explorer has nearly been identified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the final S of OATES; 'identified' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inchoate is only just begun, rudimentary and not yet fully formed.

clue.text: Shuts up drink in house, being upwardly mobile

indicators.note: in a down clue, moving upward means the whole construction is read from bottom to top
in means the drink is placed inside the house

parts.note: a semi is a semi-detached house
rum is an alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: Someone climbing the social ladder keeps quiet over a drink at home.
explanation.definitionFit: To immure someone is to wall them in or imprison them.

clue.text: Runs into one crack needing repair in rail

indicators.note: into means the runs letter goes inside the rearranged letters
something needing repair is broken, so these letters are rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Someone runs into a cracked railing that needs fixing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rail' looks like a railing in the surface, but it is the bird family.
explanation.definitionFit: The corncrake is a bird of the rail family, known for its rasping call in meadows.

clue.text: Out-and-out antique fetched better price

parts.note: one out and another out make two outs, the plural
antique means old

explanation.surface: A thoroughly genuine antique sold for more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out-and-out' looks like an adjective meaning thorough, but it is read literally as two outs.
explanation.definitionFit: To outsell is to sell for more than another item, gaining a higher sum.

clue.text: Restyle, introducing modifications in brief fashion

indicators.note: making changes to the word restyle means rearranging its letters

explanation.surface: A redesign brings changes in a short form.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking tersely is speaking briefly and concisely.

clue.text: Capital vessel appearing after a short time

indicators.note: the vessel's word is placed after the short time in the answer

parts.note: mo, short for moment, is a short time
a scow is a flat-bottomed boat

explanation.surface: A ship turns up in a city after a brief wait.
explanation.definitionFit: Moscow is the Russian capital city.

clue.text: State attorney defending doctor published notes

indicators.note: defending means the state and attorney pieces surround the other two

parts.note: ME is the abbreviation for Maine, a US state
DA is a district attorney in the US
MO is a medical officer, a doctor
a newspaper ran a story, meaning published it

explanation.surface: A state lawyer protecting a physician released written records.
explanation.walkthrough: 'State attorney' reads as one official, but it is two abbreviations that split to hold the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Memoranda are written reminders or records, the plural of memorandum.

clue.text: African passing up fruit — 1 left one, too

indicators.note: in a down clue, passing up means the fruit's word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: haws are the red berries of the hawthorn
the numeral 1 looks like the letter I
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Someone from Africa refuses fruit, and one other person goes too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'passing up' turns HAWS into SWAH. '1' is not a cross-reference to 1 across but the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Swahili is the Bantu language widely spoken in East Africa, and also names the people.

clue.text: Prepare too much type for piece of text in scripture

indicators.note: in means the piece of text is placed within the scripture abbreviation

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, part of scripture
a verse is a numbered section of a text, especially the Bible

explanation.surface: A printer sets more type than needed for a biblical passage.
explanation.definitionFit: In printing, to overset is to compose more type than the space allows.

clue.text: Act silently to secure unfinished religious work's postponement

indicators.note: to secure means the silent act holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: to mum is to act in a dumb show, performing without words

indicators.note: unfinished means the last letter of the religious work is cut off

parts.note: an oratorio is a sacred musical work

explanation.surface: Keeping quiet is a way of delaying an incomplete piece of church music.
explanation.definitionFit: A moratorium is an officially agreed delay or suspension of activity.

clue.text: Tip for getting reduced fares

explanation.surface: Advice on how to get cheaper tickets.
explanation.walkthrough: APEX (Advance Purchase Excursion) is a discounted fare booked in advance.
explanation.definitionFit: The tip is the highest point; the second sense is an acronym for cut-price advance-booked tickets.

clue.text: Crashed in banker's car — so think hard!

indicators.note: a car that has crashed is smashed up, so the letters are wrecked and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A banker has had a car accident, and is urged to think it through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crashed' rearranges the fourteen letters of IN BANKERS CAR SO, the apostrophe of banker's dropping out.
explanation.definitionFit: To strain one's mind in effort to remember or solve something is an idiom for concentrating hard.

clue.text: Give support to this sort of passenger

explanation.surface: Backing a traveller of a certain kind.
explanation.walkthrough: To stand by someone is to support them; a stand-by passenger waits for a spare seat.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to remain loyal; the noun names a traveller without a confirmed booking.

clue.text: Meal quickly follows piece of good luck

indicators.note: the quickly word comes after the good luck word in the answer

parts.note: a lucky break is a piece of good fortune
fast means quickly

explanation.surface: A lucky turn is followed swiftly by eating.
explanation.definitionFit: Breakfast is the first meal of the day.

clue.text: Recruits in French tournament action

parts.note: en is the French word for in
the lists were the arena for jousting at a medieval tournament

explanation.surface: Soldiers signing up for a joust in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Enlists is a verb meaning signs up for military service, as recruits does.

clue.text: It may be well protected in multistorey buildings

definitions.text: It may be well protected in multistorey buildings

parts.words: It may be well protected in multistorey buildings
parts.note: it sounds like a guarded water well, but the well is the shaft in which a set of steps climbs between floors

explanation.surface: A deep well is kept safe inside tower blocks.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight of steps built in a vertical shaft, called a stairwell, links the floors of a building.

clue.text: Spotted son getting kissed

parts.note: to peck is to give a quick light kiss

explanation.surface: A boy is seen getting a kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: Marked with small dots or flecks, as a speckled hen is.

clue.text: Provoking interest in the capacity of a beer taken outside

indicators.note: taken outside means the beer surrounds the other piece

parts.note: a pint is a measure of beer
qua is Latin for in the capacity of

explanation.surface: Drinks bring out curiosity.
explanation.definitionFit: Piquant means pleasantly stimulating or intriguing.

clue.text: Invention from commander at an advanced stage

parts.note: CO is commanding officer
in age means advanced in years

explanation.surface: A commanding officer comes up with something new late in life.
explanation.definitionFit: A coinage is a newly invented word or phrase.

clue.text: College visit produces cry of disapproval

parts.note: CAT stands for College of Advanced Technology
to call on someone is to visit

explanation.surface: Going to a college brings jeers.
explanation.definitionFit: A catcall is a shrill whistle or shout of derision.

clue.text: Protective cover for attractive girl outside class

indicators.note: outside means the girl surrounds the class abbreviation

parts.note: a cutie is an attractive person
CL is an abbreviation for class

explanation.surface: A pretty girl stands outside the classroom.
explanation.definitionFit: The cuticle is the protective outer layer of skin at the base of a nail.

clue.text: Lot more shaky, this, for musicians?

definitions.text: Lot more shaky, this, for musicians?

indicators.note: shaky means unsteady, so the letters are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: Musicians playing with a wavering effect.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremolo is a wavering effect in music, made by rapid repetition of a note.

clue.text: Information from base

explanation.surface: Getting facts from headquarters.
explanation.walkthrough: The lowdown is the inside facts; low-down also means mean or despicable.
explanation.definitionFit: Lowdown is slang for the relevant facts; as an adjective it means mean or contemptible.

clue.text: Reacting speedily, like adroit lottery officials

explanation.surface: Lottery staff who are good at their job respond fast.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase first comes from gunslingers fast at drawing a gun; the second sense puns on the lottery draw.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means fast to respond; skilled officials would be swift at conducting the draw.

clue.text: Southern chief's epic story

parts.note: an aga is an Ottoman military commander or chief

explanation.surface: A long tale belonging to a Southern leader.
explanation.definitionFit: A saga is a long heroic narrative, originally Norse or Icelandic.

clue.text: A heartless lie, trouble for devotee

indicators.note: heartless means the central letter of the word for a lie is removed

parts.note: a fiction is an invented story or lie
ado means fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: Lying coldly causes problems for a fan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' removes the middle T of FICTION, leaving FICION.
explanation.definitionFit: An aficionado is an enthusiast or keen fan of a pursuit.

clue.text: Row of houses — in brief, it accommodates famous old actor

indicators.note: accommodates means the short form holds the actor inside it

parts.note: it refers back to the row of houses, whose short form is the abbreviation ST
Sir Herbert Beerbohm Tree, the Victorian and Edwardian actor-manager

explanation.surface: A terrace briefly put up a celebrated thespian of the past.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' points back to the definition, so its abbreviation ST holds TREE.
explanation.definitionFit: A road lined with houses on either side is the ordinary sense of the word.

clue.text: Musical instrument left concert-hall after me

indicators.note: the left and hall pieces are placed after me in the answer

parts.note: an odeon was an ancient Greek building for musical performances

explanation.surface: A musician abandoned the venue after the speaker did.
explanation.definitionFit: A melodeon is a small reed organ or a type of button accordion.
